title: Duke of Sessa to Charles V, Sessa and Rome, Feb-Apr 1523, RAH Salazar A-27 (9/27) (DECODE R9660-R9666)

steps.what: Fetched metadata and all 55 openings of R9660-R9666 with the saved DECODE cookie; read every date line.
Recognised the cipher as the sessa1524 nomenclator from recurring code groups.
Matched the letters to Bergenroth CSP Spain vol. 2 nos. 534, 540, 541, 544, 545 (Salazar A-27 folios); R9660 and R9665 not calendared.
Read the second cipher paragraph of R9660 f. 141r with the 1524 key; about half the tokens resolve.

R9665 ff. 437-438: three cipher runs read with the sessa1524 key; the f. 437r margin note (Su Sd. por esta bula es declarado contra Francia) matches token for token and gives hef = por; two f. 437v runs carry interlinear decipherments of the time.
R9660 ff. 141r-147r (7 openings, ~2,050 cipher tokens) transcribed line by line from full-size strips by two subagents, each reading with the sessa1524 key.
Checked the R9660 margin notes as cribs: they are copyist insertions of omitted text, not decipherments.
Key extended from R9660 context: yim duque, bla ir, boz -io, loz obisp-, z o, q l, 9 e/l, gam como (probable), ruc a verb root; values cross-applied between the two halves.
R9660 read in part: ~57% of tokens resolve; ~150 code groups open with no decipherment on DECODE to value them.

outcome.method: read after matching with key from external sources
outcome.method_basis: The Sessa-Charles V key the project had rebuilt in sessa1524 from the court's decipherments in RAH Salazar A-31 was recognised here by recurring code groups and applied to the A-27 letters, with R9665's margin note and interlinear decipherments as checks.
outcome.notes: R9665 read in full (glosses + key). R9660 transcribed in full, ~57% of its tokens read (estimate from the transcription files). Four letters (R9661-R9664) read at the time and calendared by Bergenroth; R9666 clear.

gaps.detail: no decipherment on DECODE; court decipherment leaves 9/27 ff. 190, 342-343, 424-430 only at the RAH
read at the time; full decipherments are the same unimaged leaves

gaps.item: sessa1524 open groups vo, per, hay
gaps.detail: no attestation in any decipherment on DECODE

prior.where: Contemporary decipherments of four of the letters in RAH Salazar A-27, calendared in Bergenroth, CSP Spain vol. 2 nos. 534, 540, 541, 544 (1866); R9660 and R9665 not calendared

human: Set the goal; the DECODE cookie saved earlier fetched the images
